text:
Renee Cole: FYI autopay declined for Horizon Grid (acct ending 6619). invoices HG-3301, HG-3302 impacted — saw three failed authorizations this morning.
Omar Siddiq: decline codes? any fraud flags?
billing-bot: alert: payment_method=card_last4=6619 status=declined codes=[do_not_honor, avs_mismatch] attempts=3
CS-Fiona: i reached out to their AP. they say their bank is rejecting due to AVS mismatch (billing address recently changed). they've offered to wire today or update card. asked for wire template + remittance instructions.
Renee Cole: do one immediate automated retry (only one) and then pause retries. hold dunning for 48h while CS confirms payment path. if they choose wire, request remittance email and a screenshot of the bank confirmation.
AR-Marta: note for reconciliation: require remittance to include invoice numbers and amounts. when wire lands, apply to specified invoices; if unspecified, apply to oldest. set status=pending_wire.
CS-Fiona: pasted minimal wire template to client (no account numbers in Slack): ``Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.
Bank: First Partner Bank
Routing/SWIFT: [please confirm]
Reference: Horizon Grid + invoice numbers
Amount: USD XXXX``
CS-Fiona: client replied: "we will try a card update now; if it fails we will wire EOD. bank needs our SWIFT plus beneficiary address to process international wire. can you send beneficiary address?"
Renee Cole: do NOT post account numbers or full addresses in public channels. send beneficiary address via secure support ticket (ticket FIN-9017). CS-Fiona, please request remittance and ask customer to confirm the exact invoice numbers.
CS-Fiona: done. created FIN-9017 and uploaded the secure note with beneficiary address. asked client to attach payment confirmation.
billing-bot: action logged: auto_retry=attempted timestamp=1779234590 result=failed ticket=FIN-9017; account_flag=avs_mismatch
AR-Marta: set invoices HG-3301,HG-3302 status=pending_payment and tagged account=horizon_grid pending_wire. current outstanding: $68,400. threshold for service hold = $50,000.
Renee Cole: because outstanding > threshold, do not automatically suspend service; escalate to finance manager for decision if wire is delayed >72h. add high-touch flag.
LegalBot: note: if customer requests to escrow funds, legal approval required. we cannot accept escrow without signed agreement.
CS-Fiona: customer messaged: "we can wire but bank requires beneficiary full name and address in a single line; we're sending request now." attached pay_note.pdf.
AR-Marta: uploaded pay_note.pdf to FIN-9017. changed invoice state to pending_wire. scheduled manual follow-up in 48h. created AR escalation task if not cleared by Day3.
Omar Siddiq: log: created escalation PR-557 to finance lead for possible temporary credit approval.
Renee Cole: outline policy here: Day0 auto-retry attempted; Day1 pause + CS outreach; Day2 reconcile if funds landed; Day3 escalate to AR lead + finance manager for decision re: service hold or temporary credit. If wire returns or is rejected, offer ACH link https://billing.redwood.ai/ach-setup and request remittance.
CS-Fiona: client confirmed wire initiated; ETA 48-72 hours. attached bank_receipt.jpg.
billing-bot: file uploaded to FIN-9017: bank_receipt.jpg; status updated=pending_settlement
AR-Marta: added note: once settled, apply to HG-3301 then HG-3302. if partial amount arrives, apply to HG-3301 and notify CS.
Renee Cole: please set reminder for 1779321125 (~24h) to check settlement. thanks team :thumbsup:
billing-bot: reminder scheduled: check_ticket=FIN-9017 remind_at=1779321125
Omar Siddiq: noted. closing loop here unless there's a return.
CS-Fiona: will update FIN-9017 when funds hit. end of thread."
